title: Vector P4: eraser on the planar mesh, curve-preserving + eraser modes
description: P4 DONE. Curve-preserving eraser on the planar mesh (engine/planar/eraser.ts): planarEraseShape inserts the eraser stamp as subdivision edges so the P0 kernel splits fills/strokes curve-preservingly, then drops erased faces/strokes via the P3 PlanarEmitFilter. Flash 8 modes: normal/fills/lines/selected/inside + faucetEraseShape (whole fill/line). Fixed a P0 kernel bug (insertEdge intersected against RETIRED half-edges, corrupting topology for two-parallel-chords / eraser-band cases) with a one-line guard in arrangement.ts. Legacy per-object eraser kept for flag-OFF/drawing-objects (unchanged default). EVIDENCE: core 'npx vitest run planar-eraser.test.ts' = 12/12 pass; planar+legacy eraser suites = 89/89; full core suite = 5477 pass / 2 fail (only the pre-existing task-1207 flash8-empty.fla fixtures); authoring-ui = 1013/1013; swf = 1466/1466 (compile path unchanged, self-determinism intact). ORACLE: 'npx playwright test merge-drawing-oracle.spec.ts' = 8/8 pass incl new case7 'erase across a fill cuts it' (diff=0/220000) + case8 'erase a band through a disk, curve silhouette preserved' (diff=0/220000); P1-P3 cases 1-6 still diff=0/220000 (kernel fix is a pure improvement). docs/36 updated (P4 marked, eraser curve-preserving on mesh, §3.0c).
